Hello,

I saw your opening for a Brand Designer at Greenlight, and I want to share my work building visual identity systems for growing companies.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I have produced over 100 digital and print creatives while building reusable templates that cut down turnaround time for our teams. I focus on typography, layout, and strict brand consistency across all marketing collateral.

My approach is reflected in the branding kit I created for AT Creation, which established core visual systems and logo guidelines for early-stage startups. You can view that project and my other work at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Could we take five minutes next week to look over one of these case studies?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
